title: NodeVersion payload
description: Half of the PRD §40.7 `normalise(parsed)` output, and the text every citation ultimately points at (PRD §15.3). Feeds the immutable corpus `node_version` table (PRD §35.2), which is also the FTS source.

parent_stable_node_key.description: Absent for a root node. Scoped to the same document version.

canonical_text.description: Unicode-NFC-normalised ONCE, at `normalise()`. Every offset in this contract is a character offset into exactly these code points. A generic validator cannot check NFC; `validate_record()` does (violation TEXT_NOT_NFC).

text_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the exact stored `canonical_text`. Checked by `validate_record()` (violation TEXT_HASH_MISMATCH).
